about: Preregistered pass rule for sparring M2 (docs/SPARRING_M1M2.md section 5): a defender that sees the opponent's keypoints (R1-Spar-Block, weightings A and B) and its blind twin, warm-started from results/policy_mjlab_guard_footwork_r/model_7496.pt (guard_fw_r). Written before any M1/M2 code, pod or eval.
written: 2026-10-28, before any M1/M2 implementation, pod or eval

candidates.A: R1-Spar-Block-A, 1500 iterations from the widened model_7496.pt, final checkpoint
candidates.blind: R1-Spar-Block-Blind (weighting A, keypoint inputs zeroed); R1-Spar-Block-Blind-B is trained before the test if B is selected
candidates.reference: guard_fw_r = results/policy_mjlab_guard_footwork_r/policy.onnx (the warm start, its own baseline row)

eval.flags: --tier hard --no_pushes --hits 1 --keypoints truth; unaimed run first (required for pairing), then --aim chosen in the same --out
eval.keypoints: truth source (r1gym/keypoints.py), no noise, mask = in head-camera view, delayed with the episode's obs delay; blind gets zeros
eval.gym_json: every candidate uses the warm start's gym.json unchanged
eval.selection_split: val (--split val --reps 32: 1 clip x 4 distances x 32)
eval.test_split: test (--split test --reps 16: 2 clips x 4 distances x 16), run once, after selection
eval.test_controllers: guard_fw_r, the selected candidate and its blind twin in one invocation (identical episodes)

selection.rule: On val, aimed run: among A and B, those with survival >= 0.95 and survival_in_ring drop vs guard_fw_r <= 0.05; of those (of both if none qualifies) the lower exposure-weighted head clean strikes/min; a difference under 0.1/min picks A. If B is selected, train Blind-B before the test.

statistics.rate: exposure-weighted: sum of counts / sum of minutes until the R1 fell (hit_meter.n.<zone>_clean, hit_meter.secs / 60)
statistics.ratio: R = rate(candidate) / rate(reference), point estimate on all bouts
statistics.ci: 95% percentile interval of R over 4000 cluster-bootstrap resamples (seed 0) of (clip, t0) clusters, the two controllers' bouts resampled jointly (paired); a resample with a zero reference rate counts as R = inf

rule.head_vs_warm: head clean strikes/min received: R_warm <= 0.60 and CI upper bound of R_warm < 0.80
rule.head_vs_blind: CI upper bound of R_blind (candidate / blind twin, head clean/min) < 0.90
rule.ring: survival_in_ring (up and within 1 m): guard_fw_r minus candidate <= 0.05

m1_gate_before_training.frozen_warm_start_on_gpu: head clean strikes/min >= 7.7 and median impulse per head landed hit within x1.5 of 2.37 N*s ([1.58, 3.56])
m1_gate_before_training.speed: <= 2.0 s per iteration at 4096 envs (iterations 20-200 of R1-Spar-Block-A)
